description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribathkumbura West, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
